summary: Frontend-only re-test of Hi Tours homepage refinements at desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844. 12/12 functional checks passed with zero console/page errors. Verified: (1) trust-bar shows exactly 'Rated 4.7 on Google' (data-testid=rating-google) and 'Rated 4.9 on Tripadvisor' (data-testid=rating-tripadvisor) with NO numeric review counts (no '3,200', '2,100' or 'reviews' strings in the bar); (2) hero-search-input opens hero-search-suggestions panel with 58 rows alphabetical (first 5: Argentina, Asia, Australia, Bahamas, Belize), each row = round thumbnail img + destination name only (no 'Destinations' heading, no 'View trips' label, no trailing icons); (3) clicking hero-search-suggestion-egypt navigates to /afrika/aegypten and hero-search-suggestion-asia navigates to /asien; (4) desktop 'Expert advice' (data-testid=nav-phone) opens advice-popover containing advice-phone '+91 22 6140 1500', opening hours 'Mon–Sat, 9:00 – 20:00 IST' and advice-cta 'Plan for free'; clicking outside closes it; (5) testimonials-section: testimonials-rating shows 'Excellent 4.9 out of 5' with BoxStars, 7 testimonial-card entries each with brand-stars, 0 testimonial-avatar elements, no 'Trustpilot' text anywhere in section; (6) footer-badges renders 3 tags /badges/iso45001.png (500x500), /badges/cert3.png (554x554), /badges/travelife.png (1024x614) - all naturalWidth>0; (7) footer-country text = 'India' with tricolor flag rendered; (8) 5 visible footer-social icons (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Spotify) - Spotify SVG has 18x18 render size; (9) no 'Tourlane' text anywhere in body, required Hi Tours strings present ('Why Hi Tours is worth it', 'With Hi Tours', 'Unforgettable Hi Tours moments', 'Hi Tours Care'); (10) mobile hamburger opens mobile-menu; mobile-advice block at bottom contains advice-phone + advice-cta; mobile-nav-destinations accordion expands to 19 sub-items; (11) no horizontal overflow at 390px (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390); (12) console clean on both viewports.

issues: /badges/cert3.png visually renders as an IATA logo, but its alt text is 'ISO 9001 certified'. Image loads (naturalWidth=554) so the functional check passes, but the content/alt mismatch may confuse users if the intent was an actual ISO 9001 badge. Consider replacing cert3.png with a real ISO 9001 mark or updating the alt text.

action_items: Optional: Replace /badges/cert3.png with an actual ISO 9001 badge image (currently shows IATA logo while alt text says ISO 9001) OR update alt text to 'IATA member' to match the artwork.
critical_code_review_comments: Footer.jsx still renders 10 elements with data-testid='footer-social' (5 hidden desktop variant + 5 visible mobile variant on <lg; inverted on lg+) because the same testid is applied to both responsive Socials() calls. Visually only 5 are ever visible per viewport (requirement met), but for query robustness consider suffixing testids or conditionally rendering only one set per viewport.
SearchBar.jsx pick() calls setValue(d.name) after navigate() for routed destinations; navigate is synchronous within React Router but the setValue is harmless. Not a bug.
Header.jsx AdviceBody is duplicated in-place for desktop popover and mobile-advice block – clean and DRY, good.
Testimonials use inline BLUE constant '#1C6FB8' – fine but could live in a Tailwind token for reuse.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hi Tours homepage stable after iteration 13. Verified counts: search=58 rows alphabetical with round thumbnails only, testimonials=7 cards no avatars, visible footer-social=5 (incl Spotify 18x18), mobile Destinations sub-items=19. Regression navigations: Egypt->/afrika/aegypten, Asia->/asien. No Tourlane string anywhere. Console clean on desktop 1440 and mobile 390. Only cosmetic note: /badges/cert3.png renders as IATA logo despite ISO 9001 alt text.
